body:
Warning! This is a mod. This mod introduced a lot of things that haven't been explored yet in the Eternal Eclipse™ Universe by SunniePaws. As this series was creates by SunniePaws. This mod brings a lot of thing to Eternal Eclipse™ Universe and will be used for Eternal Eclipse™ Series. 

Here's what is planned for this mod
(All this Feature that this mod publish will be used by SunniePaws on Eternal Eclipse™ Official Video) 

<details>
<summary>Feature for Eternal Eclipse™ World Mod</summary>

- The Chromatic Frontier (Chroma Forest, & Ashen Wasteland) [Appear on Exploring Arc]
- The Lost World (The Lost Dimension) [Appear on The Lost World Arc] 
- Deeper Sea (The Atlantic Sea) 
- The Underworld (The Underworld, Crimson Highland, Crystal Spike, Volcanic Wonderland) [Appear on The Underworld Arc]
- More Soon

</details>
